theme_and_archetype.reference: Early-modernist financial ledgers, Swiss judicial documents, and classical museum wayfinding.
theme_and_archetype.rationale: Breaking away from the dark 'Bloomberg Terminal' SaaS look to something that feels earned, regulated, and deeply human. It signals bank-grade trust through physical, tangible design metaphors rather than cyber/hacker tropes.

primary_heading.usage: H1, H2, Hero statements, Brand Name, Fiduciary statements. ALWAYS use tracking-tight.

body_data.usage: Body copy, component text, standard readouts.

tabular_mono.usage: Financial figures, state tokens, audit logs, hash identifiers.

typography.hierarchy_rules: Extreme contrast. H1 at text-5xl/6xl in Newsreader Italic, paired with tiny uppercase Chivo Mono overlines.

layout_architecture.navigation: Thick top masthead (border-b border-[#D4D2C9]) replacing sidebars. Brand top-left, centered horizontal nav links (uppercase, tiny), tenant admin top-right.
layout_architecture.workspace: Max-width centered canvas with heavy padding (p-12). Unconstrained horizontally. Content feels like a printed page on a desk.
layout_architecture.contextual_intelligence: Drawer-based 'Pinned-Client Snapshot'. Slides in from the right edge ONLY when invoked, overlaid like a paper document on top of the canvas, pushing nothing.

component_styling.surfaces: Flat. Absolutely no drop shadows (shadow-none). Use 1px borders (border-[#D4D2C9]) to define structure, similar to ledger cells.
component_styling.corners: Sharp (rounded-none) or extremely subtle (rounded-sm) for inputs.

buttons.primary: bg-[#1E3B2D] text-white rounded-none hover:bg-[#11241B] hover:text-white transition-colors. Sharp edges.
buttons.secondary: bg-transparent border border-[#1C1E1A] text-[#1C1E1A] hover:bg-[#EBE9E0] transition-colors rounded-none.

component_styling.cards: border border-[#D4D2C9] bg-[#FCFBFA] rounded-none p-6. Top edge can have a thicker 3px colored accent border to denote state.

signature_moment_visualization.name: Live Council Session: The Radial Consensus & Transcript
signature_moment_visualization.layout: Top half: A half-circle 'Radial Consensus Dial'. The 14 specialist agents are plotted as distinct geometric nodes along the arc. A central 'Conclusion Hub' gathers their inputs. Bottom half: The 'Court Transcript'—a vertical timeline where agent reasoning strings are typed out asynchronously.
signature_moment_visualization.motion_language: Mechanical, precise, ink-spreading. No lasers or glowing beams. When an agent speaks, a crisp SVG line draws from their node to the center hub. A 'Veto' flashes the entire diagram with a sharp red outline and halts motion instantly.

screens_blueprints.dashboard: KPIs arrayed as a strict typographic grid (no standard cards). Recent sessions listed as ledger rows with monospace hash IDs and state tokens.
screens_blueprints.new_council_session: A structured, full-page intake form resembling a legal document. Massive input fields with Newsreader typography. High negative space.
screens_blueprints.live_council_session: Hero section is the Radial Consensus Dial. A sticky 'Compliance Veto Banner' at the very top (red if triggered, otherwise muted). Below the dial, the streaming reasoning timeline.
screens_blueprints.audit_compliance_viewer: Chronological trace timeline with WORM export status. High density data using Chivo Mono. Looks like an immutable printed logbook.
screens_blueprints.integrations_workspace: Grid of minimal, sharp-edged boxes for provider sync health. Use state tokens for connection status.
screens_blueprints.tenant_admin: Tabular layout for feature flags and multi-tenant controls. Utilitarian, form-heavy, strictly aligned left.

media.usage_instructions: Use 'ledger_texture' as a subtle, low-opacity (10-15%) fixed background element or overlay in the Live Session transcript area to reinforce the archival feel. Use 'fiduciary_background' for the Tenant Login or Hero section of the Marketing/Entry page, treated with a heavy off-white overlay (bg-[#F4F3ED]/80) to maintain high contrast for typography.

testing.data_testid_rule: ALL interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute formatted as kebab-case and role-based (e.g., data-testid='live-session-start-button').
